title: The Place Department
style: Moonlit grassy hollow at night, stylized low-poly, soft lantern light and mist.
negative: text, watermark, tiny sparks, glitter, embers, fireflies
notes: Unity source is breakingthrough (AGENTS.md has J's art rules: no camera shake; no tiny spark, glitter, ember or firefly particles; effects stay soft: flashes, smoke, a few feathers, rings). Warrok defends a pirate playing the piano from waves of birds.

bird-concept.description: A new bird species for the waves (concept, side view).

piano-theme.description: Music the pirate plays on the piano.
piano-theme.prompt: {prompt}, solo piano, pirate shanty feel, moonlit, loopable, instrumental

kinds._about: For the Hawkes Gen library (docs/library.md). breakingthrough/hawkes.library.json brings the bird models in (Assets/Resources/Models/Birds/<Kind>.fbx, one entity each); their look is FowlRoster.cs line. Models are made in Blender (Tools/Blender/bt_birds.py, export("<Kind>")), not by Gen.
